biography:
Juan-Carlos is a seasoned global business leader with 9+ years of expertise in technical infrastructure, adept at spearheading complex site selection negotiations on behalf of leading Global Fortune 50 firms, totaling $20+ Billion across domestic and international markets including North America, Latin America, and beyond. His strategic approach has enabled him to implement a comprehensive global strategy across 25+ global markets, finding solutions to various infrastructure needs such as Machine Learning (AI) Regions, Google Cloud Regions, AWS Availability Zones, Government Regions, Edge (PoP) Sites, Special Customer Projects, and Low Latency Regions (Local Zones).He has successfully led a diversified list of global strategic deals which includes the acquisition of 1GW+ of critical data centers, navigating through land purchases, development projects, build-to-suit endeavors, and colocation leases. He holds a Bachelor of Science from the University of Puget Sound, complemented by ongoing education at the prestigious institution, Harvard Business School. He is certified in Strategic Negotiations, Leadership, Technical Ventures, and holds certifications in Data Center Design and Machine Learning (Artificial Intelligence).At Google, he leads strategic deals for Google Cloud and AI across the Americas in collaboration with cross-functional teams, including external suppliers, sales, energy, public policy, product development, legal, engineering, and networking. His fluency in both Spanish and English fosters global connections and drives strategic initiatives with C-suite executives all around the world.
